question: Do conversation surfaces still receive kept rows with neither a server title nor transcript text? The app now renders a localized recording date/time for this event; older builds rendered Untitled Conversation. Compare within a build, not across the wording change.
zero_policy: Zero is the goal alongside conversation-list traffic in the same namespace/build. This is a bounded rendering signal, once per conversation and surface per app session, not a count of newly created empty-title rows. Age buckets describe the recording creation date, not the time a finalization failed.
